categories.title: Campsite
categories.info: If you have a Camping Kit, you may rest at Campsites for the same benefits as an Inn. Be careful; if you get attacked, you will lose the Camping Kit. Clear the surroundings before camping to prevent this.

categories.title: Dungeon
categories.info: Dungeons often house many valuables and items, but are guarded by enemies and bosses.

categories.title: Portcrystal
categories.info: Use a Ferrystone to teleport to any discovered Portcrystal

categories.title: Settlement
categories.info: Settlements are safe zones, often containing shops, inns, riftstones and quests.

categories.title: Waypoint
categories.info: Waypoints are points of interest and/or landmarks on the in-game map.

categories.title: Apothecary
categories.info: Shops sells a variety of weapons, armor and consumables.

categories.title: Armory
categories.info: Armories come in two varieties; Armor and Weapons.

categories.title: Forgotten Riftstone
categories.info: Forgotten Riftstones are scattered through the land. Activating them will either restore them (granting their unique summoning pool to the Grand Rift of Vernworth) or destroy them (summoning a high-level pawn that can be hired for free).

categories.title: Inn
categories.info: Inns allow the player to rest, replenishing their group's Health to its maximum value. Players may also spend Devotion to upgrade their skills or change their Vocation.

categories.title: Ox Station
categories.info: Ox Carts allow the player to fast travel between different location. However, this is not completely safe, and the player may be attacked during them.

categories.title: Peddler
categories.info: Peddlers are NPCs with a limited selection of wares. Offering them gifts lowers their prices.

categories.title: Riftstone
categories.info: Riftstones allow the player to summon Support Pawns.

categories.title: Vocation Guild
categories.info: Vocation Guilds are where you can manage your Voca5tions. In most settlements, this is done by the innkeeper.

categories.title: Golden Beetle
categories.info: Golden Trove Beetles permanantly increase your (or your main pawn's) carrying capacity by 0.15 kg.

categories.title: Seeker's Token
categories.info: If Seeker's Tokens are not appearing, try restarting the game from the title screen.

categories.title: Wakestone Shard
categories.info: Gathering 3 Wakestone Shards will combine into a Wakestone, which allows you to revive any dead character, including yourself.

categories.title: Armor
categories.info: Armor increases a character's defenses and resistences. There are 3 types of armor; Head, Body and Leg.

categories.title: Ring
categories.info: Rings grant special effects or resistences to their wielder. A character may wield up to 2 rings at a time.

categories.title: Chest
categories.info: Chests contain a variety of items, consumables and valuables.

categories.title: Curative
categories.info: Curative items are used to restore the player, for example replenishing Health and Stamina or removing debilitations. They may often be combined in stronger curative items.

categories.title: Loot Pile
categories.info: Loot Piles provide a random assortment of materials and valuables, depending on its kind.

categories.title: Material
categories.info: Materials are used in upgrading or enhancing equipment.

categories.title: Valuable
categories.info: Valuables are items meant to be sold or traded.

categories.title: Main Quest
categories.info: Main Quests progress the game's storyline.

categories.title: Side Quest
categories.info: Side Quests are given by NPCs once their triggers conditions have been met. They are not mandatory for story progression, although some are time-sensitive and may automatically fail if not completed quickly enough.

categories.title: Boss
categories.info: Bosses are large enemies with an overhead Health bar. They often have multiple bars, and require precise strategies or group compositions to defeat.

categories.title: Door
categories.info: Locked Doors may be opened with Keys, but can also have other requirements, such as time of day or quest completions.
